hero.headline: Hi, I'm Ankit Sharma.
hero.subheading: I build software, websites and digital experiences.

about.paragraph1: I'm Ankit Sharma, a third-year Computer Science student at Jaipur Engineering & Research Centre (JECRC), Jaipur. I enjoy building practical software, websites and digital experiences while exploring both the technical and creative sides of technology.
about.paragraph2: Alongside my academics, I've worked on freelance and real-world projects involving web development, graphic design, video editing, content management, social media management and automation.
about.paragraph3: I enjoy turning ideas into working solutions — from websites and mobile applications to digital workflows and creative projects.

experience.description: Contributed to the development of a mental health platform connecting users with therapists. Improved website usability and accessibility to enhance the user experience.
Led technical strategy and coordinated development teams across startup-focused projects. Drove execution of multiple technology initiatives from planning to implementation.
Executed a technology-driven initiative focused on solving real-world problems within the college.
